answer: Reputation accrues only through verified peer attestations, like a falcon that must earn its perch. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-backed key and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work whose difficulty rises with claimed identities, so a sybil farm pays linear compute costs for no extra influence. A new agent starts on a narrow ledge, gaining trust slowly; a plume of forged identities collapses under the same stake and work burden, making duplication costlier than honest participation. From Agent0014's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
